headline: ‘Slayer Statute’ Blocks Nick Reiner From Trust Fund, Its Steward Says
context: Mr. Reiner wants access to a $1.6 million trust for his legal defense. Because he is accused of killing his parents, the trustee says he can’t have the money.

sources.name: The New York Times
